items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: I have been associated with better musicians in all of my days, and I'm talking about from way back with doing the Earl Palmer era with David Tholomew, Ernest MacLange, Salvador Doucette

ctx.x: 86. So we were talking about dramas.

Yeah, well I was talking about the present drummer that I have in my present band today, and I stated just a minute ago that I have been associated with better musicians in all of my days, and I'm talking about from way back with doing the Earl Palmer era with David Tholomew, Ernest MacLange, Salvador Doucette, see these people are musicians, there ain't no F and A's about it. Okay, that's a caliber musician I have dealt with. All the way up my band, the original Untouchables, Larry Marino, Charlie Burbank, and…
